verdict.justification: The project focuses on the design and infrastructure of convergent TI/TO architecture and cybersecurity for an oil company, with a focus on optimizing performance, flexibility, and industrial operability. The abstract mentions analysis of current convergence TI/TO and security architectures, understanding gaps or breaches as the focus for the roadmap, analysis of governance of processes, people, and technology, followed by the construction of the implementation roadmap and documentation of guidelines established under reference architecture models.
